scope: One-second intended-send cohorts. Exact latency quantiles aggregated after timing. Ping counts are control frames encountered while reading probes in that cohort, not kernel arrival timestamps. Includes client scheduling and room batching.
stage_scope: Opt-in client clocks: wake_delay=due to ring entry; prepare=entry to all payloads ready; room_send_delay=ready to this sender's send call (includes earlier room sends); socket_send=send call through flush completion; after_send=flush completion to application read. Runtime preemption counts toward the interval it interrupts. after_send includes client receive scheduling, kernel and relay; it is not server-only latency. Component percentiles cannot be summed.
